fields.title: 📖 Ijmāʿ is not claimed lightly
fields.body:
🖋️ **Imām ash-Shāfiʿī** رحمه الله said, when he was asked whether there is ijmāʿ:

***"Yes, much praise be to Allāh: in the general obligations concerning which ignorance is not permitted. That is the ijmāʿ in which, when you say: 'The people are agreed,' you find no one around you who possesses knowledge and says: 'That is not ijmāʿ.' That is the way on which the claim of an ijmāʿ is truthful – in such matters and in some foundations of knowledge, not in its branches."***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
Ijmāʿ is not a word that one uses lightly. Whoever claims ijmāʿ must be sure that no known contradiction exists
